question: What jointless pair is called rolling pearl, and whose drops fall to earth at drinking time?
premises: jointless bound either way, thus twofold rolling is called pearl
who there at drinking time, drops go to earth
inference: Rolling pearl names jointless duality; drinkers drops fall earthward.
uncertainties: bindu drops kept literal per gloss
plain_english: Jointless bound either way, thus two, rolling pearl is said — who there at drinking time, drops go to earth.
